issues.description: f4 concentration gate in _feasibility_gate_failures lacks trade-floor override
issues.detail: In compute_phase2_objectives_from_metrics (phase2_rule_pool.py:974), when executed_trades < trade_floor, f4 is set to 0.0 ('no concentration signal on thin data'). However, in _feasibility_gate_failures, the f4 gate computes f4_val from raw metrics without applying the trade-floor override. If a rule has executed_trades < train_floor AND max_single_trade_pnl / sum_positive_trade_pnl > 0.5, the gate failures dict will show f4_concentration=1 while the actual objective uses f4=0. This creates misleading diagnostics. Algorithm correctness is not affected (the train_trade_floor gate also fires), but the diagnostic accuracy is compromised.
issues.fix: Before computing the f4 gate, add a check: if train_trades < train_floor, skip the f4 gate (leave f4_concentration=0) — matching the objective computation's intent. Alternatively, compute f4_val as 0.0 when train_trades < train_floor.

correctness_review.f4_formula_edge_cases: PASS — sum_positive=0 → f4=0 (correct, since max_single_trade_pnl also tracks positive-only trades). max_single_trade_pnl negative impossible (tracked only for net_pnl > 0). JOINT_TRAIN_VAL min() picks the less-bad leg — correct behavior.
correctness_review.gpu_engine_jax_scan: PASS — max_single_trade_pnl is correctly threaded through lax.scan with jnp.maximum update. Numerical stability is fine (simple comparison, no gradients needed). Array grew 10→13 elements; indexing in _batch_metrics_from_array (indices 10/11/12) is correct.
correctness_review.n_obj_wiring: PASS — N_OBJ module-level variable reads PHASE2_N_OBJECTIVES from config when F4_ENABLED=True (default 4), falls back to 3 otherwise. No remaining hardcoded (3,) or (pop_size, 3) anywhere in evolution directory. _pareto_diagnostics uses shape-adaptive guards (>= 2, >= 3).
correctness_review.non_dominate_rank: PASS — EvoX non_dominate_rank(f) accepts torch.Tensor of any shape; function is dimension-agnostic.
correctness_review.objective_array_shape: PASS — All np.full((pop_size, ...), inf) calls use N_OBJ. _plateau_diversity_restart uses np.full(N_OBJ, np.inf). No shape mismatch risk when F4_ENABLED=False.

performance_review.gpu_engine_array_growth: PASS — 10→13 elements = 3 floats per call. With batch_size=128, n_gen=13, n_clusters=3: ~150K extra floats total. Negligible.
performance_review.nsga3_4d_pareto: PASS — non_dominate_rank is O(M·N²) with M=obj count. Going from 3→4 objectives is marginal for pop_size=120. _get_reference_vectors with uniform_sampling(pop_size, 4) handles 4D correctly.
performance_review.cpu_engine_per_trade_tracking: PASS — max_single_trade_pnl is O(1) per positive trade (simple max comparison). No regression.

security_review: PASS — No security-sensitive code paths. All changes are internal metric computations and config constants.

test_adequacy.f4_unit_tests: PASS — 5 tests: outlier_trade (f4=1.0), uniform_trades (f4=0.0125), disabled_returns_3, zero_below_trade_floor, default_is_3_when_config_deleted. All test compute_phase2_objectives_from_metrics directly — the production code path.
test_adequacy.property_tests: PASS — 2 Hypothesis tests (test_property_29, 29b) with max_examples=100, bounded floats [0, 1e6], no NaN/Inf. Properly monkeypatched with undo in finally block. Test f4 monotonicity (increasing max_pnl → non-decreasing f4) and inverse monotonicity (increasing sum_pos → non-increasing f4).
test_adequacy.joint_min_gate_test: PASS — test_f4_gate_uses_joint_min_when_joint_train_val_enabled correctly sets train f4=0.9 (>0.5 floor) and val f4=0.2 (≤0.5 floor), asserts f4_concentration=0 (gate passes with joint min).
test_adequacy.default_mismatch_test: PASS — test_f4_default_is_three_objectives_when_config_deleted uses monkeypatch.delattr to delete PHASE2_F4_ENABLED, then asserts 3 objectives and no f4 key. Both getattr defaults now False (fix verified).
test_adequacy.coverage_gap: f4_concentration gate when trades < train_floor not explicitly tested in _feasibility_gate_failures (see MEDIUM finding above).

maintainability_review.f4_epsilon: PASS — PHASE2_F4_EPSILON=1e-6 is adequate. Division by near-zero only happens when sum_positive is essentially zero; in that case max_single_trade_pnl is also zero (positive-only tracking).
maintainability_review.n_obj_module_level: ACCEPTABLE — N_OBJ computed at import time. Stale-value risk exists if config changes at runtime, but config is set at startup and never mutated in production. Tests monkeypatch at function level, testing through compute_phase2_objectives_from_metrics (not through N_OBJ).
maintainability_review.audit_linkage: PASS — config.py:536 has comment '→ fixes audit finding #2 (outlier-driven f3 from uncapped time-exit returns)'. Grep-able.
maintainability_review.f4_concentration_gate_integration: PASS — Clean 10th gate. Gate breakdown dict in both NSGA2 and NSGA3 paths includes f4_concentration. _feasibility_gate_failures docstring updated from 9→10 gates. No bolt-on feel.

regression_check.f4_disabled_bit_identical: PASS — Verified by test_f4_disabled_returns_three_objectives and test_f4_default_is_three_objectives_when_config_deleted. When PHASE2_F4_ENABLED=False, objectives.shape=(3,), no f4 key in metrics.

summary: Code review PASS. Implementation correctly adds f4 return-concentration as 4th NSGA-III objective with proper engine tracking, NSGA-III plumbing, pool admission gate, and regression guard. All 4 spec-review findings resolved in fix commit c89c087. One MEDIUM finding: _feasibility_gate_failures should skip the f4 gate when trades < train_floor to match the objective's trade-floor override (diagnostic accuracy only — algorithm correctness unaffected). All 226 tests pass with no regressions.
